question.text: Which of the following hydrogen bonds is likely to be the weakest?

solution.text: For $x-\stackrel{\delta}{H}^{+} \cdots \stackrel{\delta-}{O}$ hydrogen bond; lower the electronegativity of $x$; lower is the residual $\delta+$ change induced on $\mathrm{H}$ & hence a lesser electrostatic attraction is expected between $\mathrm{H}$ & $\mathrm{O}$; thus diminishing bond strength. Hence, chosen option is the atom of lowest electronegativity, i.e. C.
